environment.description: ECS Fargate task with platform version 1.4.0 running identical container image. Task definition specifies readonlyRootFilesystem: true in containerDefinitions. No additional volume mounts, tmpfs mounts, or EFS filesystems are attached to the task. The container's ephemeral storage (20GB default) inherits the read-only constraint from the rootfs setting. Task networking uses awsvpc mode with security group sg-0a4f2c8e limiting egress to SQS VPC endpoint only. Note: the readonlyRootFilesystem flag in ECS Fargate applies at the overlay filesystem layer, meaning all write syscalls (open with O_WRONLY/O_RDWR, mkdir, etc.) to any path return EROFS regardless of in-container file permissions or user context.
